proves: A bad checksum on 0x10 is reported as result 0x02, but the command is still executed: the reply still carries rotation 0x00 and mode 0xFF. Error reporting does not suppress the status payload.

request.checksumAlgorithm: LE16 sum of bytes 0..45 inclusive (HIDC included)

notes: Implication for a Linux driver: result 0x02 means 'your sum was wrong', not 'the request was discarded'. Never treat 0x02 as proof the device ignored it.
Whether a 0x01 frame with result 0x02 is applied to the panel is unknown: the display has no read-back and no camera view was available.
